events.title: Sebastian Bronk at Schatzi Bar
events.summary: Bandsintown listed Dutch producer/DJ Sebastian Bronk at Schatzi Bar in Ischgl on January 8, 2026 at 16:00, with free admission. The listing describes his sound as spanning bass, disco, house, tech house, techno and harder styles.
